meta.title: Coach Gary Payne | Football Coaching — North Carolina
meta.description: Professional football coaching at Trinity High School. Offensive expertise, personalized training, and real results.

about.name: Coach Gary Payne
about.title: AHC/OC
about.bio:
Coach Gary Payne brings 24 years of experience running the Gun T system at Trinity High School. With a sharp offensive mind and a track record of developing athletes who perform at the next level, Coach Payne is known for making practice reps count.

From route running to pre-snap reads to protection schemes — Coach Payne delivers the kind of coaching that shows up in the box score.

hero.headline: Trinity High School's Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized offensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: Gun T System Coaching
services.description: Installation and development of the Gun T offense — from core concepts to advanced adjustments that put defenses in conflict.

services.title: Skill Position Development
services.description: Individual coaching for QBs, WRs, RBs, and TEs focused on technique, route running, footwork, and pre-snap reads.

services.title: Offensive Playbook & Film Study
services.description: Playbook design tailored to your personnel, plus film sessions that sharpen in-game decision making for players and staff.
